title: Compatible marked finite-free models for a nilpotent quotient tower
statement: For a sequence of surjective maps of commutative rings with nilpotent kernels, let E_n be derived objects with transitions whose adjunction transposes are isomorphisms. If E_0 is pseudo-coherent [def-pc-ring-pseudo-coherent-complex], there exist bounded-above finite-free complex representatives P_n, markings beta_n, a common upper cutoff, degreewise surjective transitions u_n representing the given derived transitions, and ordinary scalar-extension isomorphisms theta_n whose adjoints degreewise equal u_n. The representing equality includes the canonical exact-derived-restriction factorization. The derived category, where present, is [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Pseudo-coherence means [def-pc-ring-pseudo-coherent-complex].

source.place: Tag 0CQF, first induction; Tags 0H76, 0BCB and 0BCA for marked lifting

proof.text: Choose a bounded-above finite-free marked model P_0 from pseudo-coherence. Fix its upper cutoff b. At level n keep the model P_n and its marking as one dependent pair. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-nilpotent-marked-free-complex-step] to that pair and t_n to obtain the next model, its marking, the surjective transition and its scalar-extension isomorphism, all with cutoff b. Classical dependent recursion on the natural numbers iterates this one-step construction. Projecting the resulting pairs and witnesses gives exactly every asserted compatibility, bound and marking equation.

theorem exists_nilpotent_finiteFree_complexTower
    (R : ℕ → Type u) [∀ n, CommRing (R n)]
    (φ : ∀ n, R (n + 1) →+* R n)
    (hsurj : ∀ n, Function.Surjective (φ n))
    (hnil : ∀ n, IsNilpotent (RingHom.ker (φ n)))
    [∀ n, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{max u v} (R n))]
    (L : ∀ n, DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} (R (n + 1))) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} (R n)))
    (adjφ : ∀ n, L n ⊣ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (φ n)).mapDerivedCategory)
    (Eₙ : ∀ n, DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} (R n)))
    (t : ∀ n, Eₙ (n + 1) ⟶
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (φ n)).mapDerivedCategory.obj (Eₙ n))
    (hred : ∀ n, IsIso (((adjφ n).homEquiv (Eₙ (n + 1)) (Eₙ n)).symm (t n)))
    (hpc : IsPseudoCoherent (Eₙ 0))
 :
    ∃ (Pₙ : ∀ n, CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} (R n)) ℤ)
      (b : ℤ) (βₙ : ∀ n, Q.obj (Pₙ n) ≅ Eₙ n)
      (uₙ : ∀ n, Pₙ (n + 1) ⟶
        ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (φ n)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj (Pₙ n))
      (θₙ : ∀ n, ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (φ n)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (Pₙ (n + 1)) ≅ Pₙ n),
      (∀ n, (Pₙ n).IsStrictlyLE b) ∧
      (∀ n i, Module.Free (R n) ((Pₙ n).X i) ∧ Module.Finite (R n) ((Pₙ n).X i)) ∧
      (∀ n i, Function.Surjective ((uₙ n).f i)) ∧
      (∀ n i, ((ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj (φ n)).homEquiv
        ((Pₙ (n + 1)).X i) ((Pₙ n).X i) ((θₙ n).hom.f i)) = (uₙ n).f i) ∧
      (∀ n, Q.map (uₙ n) = (βₙ (n + 1)).hom ≫ t n ≫
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (φ n)).mapDerivedCategory.map (βₙ n).inv ≫
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (φ n)).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app (Pₙ n))
